name: Jasmine Paolini
intro: Jasmine Paolini is a smiling star from Italy. She is small but super fast. In 2024 she reached two Grand Slam finals. A Grand Slam is one of the four biggest tournaments.
story: Jasmine's dad and uncle taught her tennis at age five. She is only 5 feet 4 inches tall. She makes up for it with quick feet and a big heart. In 2024 she won Olympic gold in doubles. She won two matches here in New York this year. Next time, look for that smile!

funFacts.text: She speaks Polish! Her grandma is from Poland.
Her grandpa is from Ghana, a country in Africa.
Her dad Ugo ran a bar in their little town.
Her little brother William plays tennis too.
She once said she wished she was taller. Then she could serve better.
She won Olympic gold in doubles with Sara Errani in 2024.
Sara Errani is her doubles partner and now her coach too!

watchFor: Watch her bouncy feet and huge smile, even after losing a point.

notes: Birth 1996-01-04 (born Castelnuovo di Garfagnana; trained at and lives in Bagni di Lucca, kept as hometown), 163 cm / 5 ft 4, right-handed/2HBH, started at five with father and uncle, brother William plays tennis, 2024 RG + Wimbledon finals, 2024 Olympic doubles gold with Errani, quote 'I wish I was taller, because I could serve better', 2026 US Open 3R loss to Cirstea: confirmed on en.wikipedia.
